original_title: Storia e memoria
note: Portuguese translation of the broader Einaudi encyclopaedia selection. Candidate w-234618, History and Memory, contains only Past/Present, Antique/Modern, Memory and History; it omits several essays in the cited volume. Italian ISBN confirmed in the 1986 catalogue record.

original_title: A história cultural: entre práticas e representações
note: Portuguese selection translated from French essays, with a new introduction. Its eight essays differ from w-302724: three concern reading and the last two concern popular politics and state formation. Contents checked against the 1989 Revista de História review (10.11606/issn.2316-9141.v0i121p149-154); ISBN confirmed in a later Difel catalogue record.

original_title: O poder simbólico
note: Portuguese collection of translated essays, translated by Fernando Tomaz. Neither the single article Sur le pouvoir symbolique nor Language and Symbolic Power has the same contents.

original_title: Apologie pour l'histoire ou Métier d'historien
note: Portuguese translation of the posthumous methodological book, first published in 1949; the supplied Bloch candidate is Feudal Society, a different work. ISBN confirmed for the cited 2001 Zahar edition.

original_title: L'écriture de l'histoire
note: Portuguese translation of L’écriture de l’histoire. Prefer the French original over candidate w-301626, The Writing of History.

original_title: L'invention du quotidien. 1, Arts de faire
note: The 1994 Brazilian edition is volume 1, Artes de fazer. Match the French L’Invention du quotidien record rather than its English translation w-453.

original_title: Microfísica do poder
note: Brazilian selection organized by Roberto Machado from French texts, interviews and lectures; no single French book is its original. Power/knowledge and the other candidate anthologies overlap but are different selections. ISBN confirmed in the library’s Graal record dated 1979.

original_title: Customs in Common
note: Portuguese translation of Customs in Common; publisher confirms original title and 1998 edition. The supplied candidate title is truncated bibliographic prose but identifies the same book.

original_title: La mémoire collective
note: Portuguese translation of the posthumous La mémoire collective, not Les cadres sociaux de la mémoire. Prefer the French original over w-109895, The Collective Memory.

original_title: Casa-grande & senzala: formação da família brasileira sob o regime de economia patriarcal
note: Later Portuguese edition of the same book, first published in 1933. The 1936 candidate is an earlier edition of that work; exclude the comic adaptation and quotation anthology.

original_title: Age of Extremes: The Short Twentieth Century, 1914–1991
note: Portuguese translation of Age of Extremes. The candidate uses the American subtitle, A History of the World, 1914–1991; it is the same book.

original_title: Über den Prozess der Zivilisation: soziogenetische und psychogenetische Untersuchungen
note: Portuguese title of The Civilizing Process, published in two volumes. The citation omits a volume designation; match the general German work record. Its supplied 1937 date is erroneous: first publication was 1939.

original_title: Os donos do poder: formação do patronato político brasileiro
note: Later edition of Faoro’s book first published in 1958, substantially revised and expanded in 1975; same work under the brief’s edition rule.

original_title: Miti, emblemi, spie: morfologia e storia
note: Portuguese translation of the complete Italian essay collection. Prefer w-955, the original, over English translation w-238836, Clues, Myths, and the Historical Method.

original_title: Il formaggio e i vermi: il cosmo di un mugnaio del '500
note: Portuguese translation of Il formaggio e i vermi. Prefer the 1976 Italian original over the later English candidate.

original_title: The Making of the English Working Class
note: Brazilian translation issued in three volumes in 1987. Candidate w-849 identifies the same English work despite its 1964 edition date; first publication was 1963.

original_title: O tempo saquarema: a formação do Estado imperial
note: Mattos’s book first published by Hucitec in 1987, based on his 1985 thesis. The citation is the 2004 fifth edition; no candidate works were supplied. ISBN confirmed for the original edition.

original_title: Pour une histoire politique
note: Portuguese translation of the collective volume edited by René Rémond, first published by Seuil in 1988; 2003 is the second Brazilian edition.

original_title: A economia das trocas simbólicas
note: Brazilian selection of French essays organized by Sergio Miceli, first published in 1974. Neither Ce que parler veut dire nor The Field of Cultural Production has the same contents; individual candidate articles are only parts. ISBN confirmed for 2007.

original_title: The Question of Cultural Identity
container: Modernity and Its Futures, edited by Stuart Hall, David Held and Tony McGrew (Polity Press/Open University, 1992), pp. 273–326
note: Portuguese standalone translation of Hall’s chapter, not Questions of Cultural Identity. A candidate whole-volume Modernity record is not a chapter-level match. Brazilian National Library confirms the original title and ISBN of the cited 2006 edition.
